text.p: Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy said on Monday an offering of 13 million new K shares, first announced on April 14, would be priced at 42.00 markka per share both to retail and institutional investors.
Its K series stock in Helsinki earlier closed at 43.80.

It also said in a statement that an offering of shares by the Finnish state to international and Finnish institutional investors, which it called a global offering, had ended: "The demand in the global offering exceeded the number of shares offered by nearly three times," the statement said. @
The company said earlier this month the offerings would total 32.1 million shares, including 13 million new K series shares, to institutions, the public and employees.
It referred only to the new share offering in its statement on Monday: no-one at Rautaruukki was available to comment.
After expenses, Rautaruukki said the offerings would bring in about 435 million markka for Rautaruukki and 615 million markka for the state. @

Rautaruukki said the global offering would reduce the state's holding in it to about 48 percent from 68.7 percent now, and that this could fall further to about 42 percent if all additional subscription options were exercised.
The new offering also included a directed offering at retailer Kesko amounting to 100 million markka in payment for its Keskometalli unit, Rautaruukki said.
